correctness.rationale: Independent Bernoulli Laplace products prove Poisson log-time point-process limit on eps-away-from-zero windows; parity multiplication mixes orientation; deterministic eps truncation and 1-Lipschitz compactness yield C([0,T]) weak convergence. Invariant generator calculation and boundary flux give the explicit beta marginal without assuming a density; sign coupling ensures uniqueness. Fubini and an elementary power integral prove exact two-time covariance and c=1/2 threshold. Bounded weak limits justify fourth moment and Binder limit. Executed standalone checker passed 53 deterministic tests; no finite test is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: This solves a natural missing critical-displacement characterization of a current persistent-walk phase transition: it proves full-path universality under only kp_k->c, obtains an analytical Binder parameter curve in place of solely numerical crossing, and exposes a distinct two-time aging threshold at c=1/2 separating growth, logarithmic growth and saturation.
